# tenarium_rollout (Resource)

A feature rollout: turns a feature on for a stable percentage of the tenants matching its cohort filters, independently of plans. A tenant gets the feature when the rollout is enabled, the tenant is not excluded, and it is either included or matches every filter that is set and falls within the percentage. A tenant's own feature override always wins. Rollouts are platform-only (`plans:write`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn new-editor on for 10% of the EU tenants on the pro plan that carry
# beta = "yes", always for acme and never for globex.
resource "tenarium_rollout" "new_editor" {
  feature    = "new-editor"
  percentage = 10
  plans      = [tenarium_plan.pro.id]
  regions    = ["eu"]
  labels     = { beta = "yes" }
  include    = [tenarium_tenant.acme.id]
  exclude    = [tenarium_tenant.globex.id]
  enabled    = true # false is the kill switch
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature` (String) Feature the rollout turns on. A feature has at most one rollout. Changing it replaces the rollout.
- `percentage` (Number) Share of the matching tenants (0-100) that get the feature. A stable hash of feature and tenant ID decides, so raising it keeps the tenants that already have the feature.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Kill switch: `false` turns the feature off for every tenant of the rollout. Defaults to `true`.
- `exclude` (Set of String) Tenant IDs that never get the feature.
- `include` (Set of String) Tenant IDs that always get the feature (while enabled). Together with `exclude` at most 1000 IDs.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only tenants carrying all of these labels match.
- `plans` (Set of String) Only tenants on one of these plans match.
- `regions` (Set of String) Only tenants in one of these regions match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The feature name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By feature name.
terraform import tenarium_rollout.new_editor new-editor
```
